items.guidance: Because @prisma/client is present, look for a prisma/schema.prisma file and a prisma/migrations folder in the api directory used by api/Dockerfile. If migrations exist, report npx prisma migrate deploy as the command, and confirm the prisma CLI and the schema file are present in the final image, since prisma is often only a dev dependency. If only a schema exists without migrations, report that instead.

Check which modules import api/utils/sqsClient.js and whether they send or receive messages, and whether workers/sqs-consumer.js is the consumer. Report the producer file, the consumer file, and whether production needs this queue at all. Also report that SQS_QUEUE_URL must point at a queue the deployment can reach, because the facts do not list SQS as a Deployz-managed service.
